title: Finite-rank extension of a square-zero-valued field derivation
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be fields of characteristic $p>0$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative $k$-algebra and $r:\Lambda\to K$ a ring map compatible with the $k$-structures. Let $I\subseteq\ker(r)$ be an ideal with $(\ker r)I=0$. Let $\sigma_0:K\to\Lambda$ be a ring section of $r$. Let $\theta:k\to\Lambda$ be additive, with $\theta(k)\subseteq I$, $\theta(1)=0$, and $\theta(ab)=i(a)\theta(b)+i(b)\theta(a)$, where $i:k\to\Lambda$ is the given structure map; derivations are as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Suppose $H_1(L_{K/k})$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] is finite dimensional over $K$. Then there exist an additive map $D:K\to\Lambda$ and a finite subset $f\subseteq I$ such that $D(1)=0$, $D(xy)=\sigma_0(x)D(y)+\sigma_0(y)D(x)$ for every $x,y\in K$, $D(K)\subseteq I$, and $\theta(a)-D(a)\in\operatorname{span}_k(f)$ for every $a\in k$, with the span formed using the given $k$-algebra structure on $\Lambda$.

source.place: Tag 07FG, proof: differential-basis, finite Jacobi--Zariski kernel support, and choice of the derivation D; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FG

proof.text: Give I its K-module structure by Module.compHom I sigma0. For a in k, the difference sigma0(i_K(a))-i_Lambda(a) lies in ker(r) by the section and compatibility equalities. Its product with every y in I vanishes by (ker r)I=0. This proves restricted K-scalar multiplication agrees with the given k-action and supplies IsScalarTower k K I. Package theta as the integer-linear derivation delta:k to I using additivity, theta(1)=0 and the product rule.

Let phi be KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange Z k K. Jacobi--Zariski exactness identifies its kernel with the range of H1Cotangent.delta Z k K. The hypothesis makes the source finite over K, so the kernel is finite over K. Apply lem-weil-pbc-finite-kernel-scalar-extension to V=Omega(k/Z), W=Omega(K/Z), M=I and ell=delta.liftKaehlerDifferential.

Compose the resulting K-linear g with the universal derivation of K over Z to obtain d:K to I, and compose its underlying additive map with I inclusion to define D:K to Lambda. The universal derivation gives D(1)=0 and the sigma0 product rule; ideal membership is the subtype property. Let the finite family in Lambda be the image under inclusion of the finite family in I. Evaluate the finite-error assertion at da; naturality of differential base change and the universal lifting identity turn it into theta(a)-D(i_K(a)). Mapping the k-span through the k-linear ideal inclusion gives exactly the required k-span in Lambda.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07FG finite-support argument, using differentials over Z and an arbitrary basis, with Mathlib middle Jacobi--Zariski exactness; no prime-field injectivity statement is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_rank_defect_derivation
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (K : Type w) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    (r : Λ →+* K) (hcomm : r.comp (algebraMap k Λ) = algebraMap k K)
    (I : Ideal Λ) (hI : I ≤ RingHom.ker r) (hkill : RingHom.ker r * I = ⊥)
    (σ0 : K →+* Λ) (hσ0 : r.comp σ0 = RingHom.id K)
    (theta : k →+ Λ) (htheta : ∀ a : k, theta a ∈ I)
    (htheta_one : theta 1 = 0)
    (htheta_mul : ∀ a b : k,
      theta (a * b) = algebraMap k Λ a * theta b + algebraMap k Λ b * theta a)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (hH : Module.Finite K (H1Cotangent k K)) :
    ∃ (D : K →+ Λ) (f : Finset Λ),
      D 1 = 0 ∧
      (∀ x y : K, D (x * y) = σ0 x * D y + σ0 y * D x) ∧
      (∀ x : K, D x ∈ I) ∧
      (f : Set Λ) ⊆ I ∧
      (∀ a : k, theta a - D (algebraMap k K a) ∈
        Submodule.span k (f : Set Λ))
